commands.command:
set -e; TELE=/tmp/phase2d-resource-short-live.jsonl; R=/tmp/phase2d-resource-result.txt; test -s "$TELE"; python3 - "$TELE" <<'PY'
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1])
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in p.read_text().splitlines() if x.strip()]
app=[r['app'] for r in rows if r.get('app')]
helper=[r['helper'] for r in rows if r.get('helper')]
print('telemetry_rows=',len(rows))
print('duration_device_s=',round(rows[-1]['device_uptime_s']-rows[0]['device_uptime_s'],3))
print('app_samples=',len(app),'app_pids=',sorted({x['pid'] for x in app}))
print('helper_samples=',len(helper),'helper_pids=',sorted({x['pid'] for x in helper}))
assert len(rows)>=20
assert len(app)>=20
assert len(helper)>=20
assert len({x['pid'] for x in app})==1
assert len({x['pid'] for x in helper})==1
def report(name, seq):
    first,last=seq[0],seq[-1]
    rss=(first['vmrss_kb'],last['vmrss_kb'],max(x['vmrss_kb'] for x in seq))
    fd=(first['fd_count'],last['fd_count'],max(x['fd_count'] for x in seq))
    th=(first['thread_count'],last['thread_count'],max(x['thread_count'] for x in seq))
    print(name+'_rss_kb_start_end_peak=',*rss)
    print(name+'_fd_start_end_peak=',*fd)
    print(name+'_threads_start_end_peak=',*th)
    assert fd[1] <= fd[0] + 4, (name,'fd',fd)
    assert th[1] <= th[0] + 4, (name,'threads',th)
    assert rss[1] <= rss[0] + 16384, (name,'rss',rss)
report('app',app)
report('helper',helper)
print('resource_trend_evidence_green=true')
PY
 if [ -s "$R" ]; then grep -E 'duration_ms=60000|all_heartbeats_ok=true|active_throughout=true|duration_ok=true|prepared_after_abort=false|active_after_abort=false|heartbeat_after_abort=false|threads_stopped=true|endurance_ok=true|downlink_bytes_read=|uplink_bytes_written=' "$R" || true; fi; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; echo current_call_state=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '[:space:]'); echo helper_pid=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge:call_media 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]'); echo bluetooth=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]'); test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 0; test -z "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge:call_media 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 1; echo resource_postmortem_green=true
